title: About
text:
Design For Impact is a collaborative scaffold for helping statistical collaborators maximize and communicate the value of their work.




The project brings alignment, intentionality, and translation into the everyday conversations that shape evidence-based work. More about its development, evaluation, and research foundations will be shared here in a future release.

title: The Tool
text:
Design For Impact gives collaborators a structured place to connect project context, analytical choices, and decision-ready communication.




The combined Tool + Guide brings the worksheet and its practical prompts together in one downloadable resource.
Download the Tool + Guide



Use the tool before kickoff to prepare thoughtful questions, return to it as project constraints change, and use it to shape a closeout narrative that is meaningful to the people making decisions.



Instructor resources will be available here in a future release. They will support teaching the connection between statistical choices, collaboration, and the communication of evidence.

title: Design For Impact
text:
Design For Impact


A collaborative scaffold for maximizing and communicating impact in statistical collaboration.


Download the Tool + Guide Learn More







A shared workspace for the conversations that shape a project.







Impact doesn’t happen automatically—it requires alignment, intentionality, and translation.







From evidence to action.


Design For Impact builds on the Q1Q2Q3 framework developed by Vance and colleagues, which moves from qualitative context gathering, through quantitative analysis, to qualitative interpretation.





Q1


Qualitative


Alignment



→



Q2


Quantitative


Intentionality



→



Q3


Qualitative


Translation






Alignment


Establish the project’s broader vision, intended impact, and expectations for the partnership.




Intentionality


Choose the design, dataset, analytical approach, and communication products that enable the intended impact.




Translation


Develop an audience-specific, evidence-based narrative connecting the findings to the stakeholders, decisions, or actions identified in Q1.





The tool turns these principles into five practical components.

Explore the Tool →







A scaffold, not a script.


Use the tool as a shared document between you and your collaborator, or adapt it to your needs.





Prepare


Review the guide and develop questions before kickoff.




Align


Establish Q1 with collaborators and confirm shared understanding.




Analyze


Develop Q2 and revisit it as evidence or constraints change.




Translate


Use Q3 to shape decision-ready closeout communication.
